title: Read a board's DRC settings and run a batch DRC
summary: Shows where DRC settings live in the .NET API: the online DRC switch in the PCB system options, the DRCEnabled flag on each rule, and IPCB_Board.RunBatchDesignRuleCheck to write an HTML or text report without a dialog.
phrasings: run design rule check from code and save the report
turn online DRC on or off
count enabled design rules by kind

commands.name: ReportDrcSettings
commands.description: Report the online DRC switch and the board's design rules

commands.name: EnableOnlineAndBatchCheck
commands.description: Turn online DRC on or off

commands.name: RunBatchDrc
commands.description: Run a batch DRC and write the report file
commands.params: Out=<folder or file> (default temp folder)|Format=Html|Text (default Html)
